info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Health Monitoring Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Starts watching a TCP and an HTTP target, reads and lists them (by the asset they watch, by health), reads the summary, updates the definition (a new name and interval; what is left out takes its default again), pauses and resumes a check (the summary counts the paused apart), and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the service is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-HLM-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation, the target policy (the cloud metadata address and name, link-local, unspecified and multicast addresses, IPv6 link-local, the decimal-integer spelling, credentials, a query or a fragment in the URL, a non-http scheme, a TCP target without a port or with a port out of range), interval, timeout and threshold ranges, duplicate names (409), illegal transitions, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. The targets point at an address nothing answers on and the interval is an hour, so the scheduler stays quiet; the live probing, the thresholds and the recovery are proved by the platform smoke (health-monitoring-smoke). It files everything under its own generated tenant id (hlmOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
